tools.name: render_structure
tools.description: Draw a chemical structure, or a reaction scheme (reaction), as a publication-quality image (PNG by default), with its name, SMILES, formula and a link that opens it in HexSketch at hexsketch.com, where the user can edit it by drawing. Give structures as SMILES, not names. Check the name and formula

tools.name: name_structure
tools.description: The IUPAC name of a structure, generated offline. Returns name null with a reason when the structure is outside what HexSketch names.

tools.name: analyze_structure
tools.description: Name, SMILES (with stereochemistry), molecular formula, exact (monoisotopic) mass, molecular weight, elemental analysis and isotope pattern (m/z). Mixtures and salts are also given per structure. For a drawing (a HexSketch link or CDXML), also its arrows and text: the reagents and conditions written

tools.name: validate_structure
tools.description: Check a structure, typically a SMILES you wrote, before presenting it: catches unreadable SMILES, names given instead of SMILES, aromatic rings that cannot be kekulized, atoms over or under their valence, unusual charges and radicals. Returns ok, issues (error, warning or note), and the name and for

tools.name: convert_structure
tools.description: Convert a structure to SMILES (with stereochemistry), a molfile (V2000), CDXML (ChemDraw) or a HexSketch link.

tools.name: compare_structures
tools.description: Are two structures the same compound, and the same stereoisomer? The inputs may be in different formats (a SMILES against a drawing, for instance).

tools.name: structure_link
tools.description: A link that opens the structure in HexSketch (in the browser, nothing to install), where the user can edit it by drawing and copy it back. Give it to the user whenever they may want to change a structure.

tools.name: sketch_updates
tools.description: Used by the HexSketch editor to fetch what show_in_sketcher asked it to show. Not for the model.

tools.name: sketch_sync
tools.description: Used by the HexSketch editor to report the user's drawing, so read_sketcher can see it. Not for the model.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "validate_structure" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
